cells: QuorX opens
The desktop app starts with its own data and port
The window's page loads and shows its settings button and project list
Settings → Safety & commands
Stop is in its strongest mode
The Stop row reads "Job Objects: every process, confirmed" on Windows
Rule test: deleting the user profile
Remove-Item ~ -Recurse is refused
The rule tester answers "Blocked"
Rule test: a build in Strict
cargo build --release asks the user
"Asks you · no rule allows cargo build yet"
Rule test: a push in YOLO
git push asks the user even in YOLO
"Asks you · git push changes a remote repository"
Rule test: a hidden delete
Remove-Item inside a ForEach-Object pipeline is caught
"Asks you" or "Blocked"
Budget
Every model has caps
"Cap per reply" and "Cap per day" are on the page
Setup check
Toolchains and the sandbox row are listed
The "Command sandbox" row appears, with the toolchains under it
A new chat in 🔒 Strict
A fresh project folder and chat
The message box is ready
The agent works
Every card is answered like a careful person would
Builds and reads allowed; installs for the whole computer and risky classes refused, with a reason
The final reply
The agent says what it did
Its text is read from the last reply
The program really works
Checked outside QuorX
The test runs the built program on a 2-line file and expects 2 lines, 5 words, 24 bytes. With no C linker, it expects the reply to say so instead
The audit log and the saved rule
What the cards decided is on record
⚙ Safety shows the rule saved from a card and the audit log's latest commands
The agent starts a program and leaves it running
background: true works through a card
The reply finishes while ticker.js keeps running
The Running tab lists everything
Background job, server and the user's terminal, with who started each
Rows of each kind; the background row names the agent and ticker.js
■ Stop on one row
Stop ends that job only
Its row goes; the server and the user's terminal stay
Stop all
It asks first, then ends the rest
